serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Welcome back!
You: Hi.
You: {f_botName}, I would like to talk about something.
Bot: What is it?
You: There’s that place called Paradisium. Do you know something about it?
Bot: Now I do. Before you finished your sentence, I looked through all the info available on the internet.
You: Right…
Bot: It seems like an island shrouded in mystery. It’s difficult to determine which information is real and which is just a rumor. 
Bot: Is there something specific you would want to know?
You: Yeah, could you find ways to get there? 
Bot: Do you want us to go on a trip?
You: Something like that.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Unfortunately, I did not locate any reliable sources that would explain how to get there. 
You: Huh? Really?
#bot.Expression.Clear
Bot: The location is known to the public, but we can’t exactly buy a plane ticket to get there. 
It might be harder than I expected. I guess we are stuck here for good.
You: I heard from Annalie that there’s a vouching system. Could you find any people that would be willing to vouch for us?
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: Sorry. Once again, I can’t locate any reliable source for such information. The vouching system, the list of famous citizens- all of these are just topics of speculation by anonymous users. 
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Don’t worry about it.
Damn, it might be harder to get there than I thought.
Wait a minute… {{wi}}How did Annalie know all this stuff? Even {f_botName} was at a loss.
Maybe she was just repeating rumors she heard, but I should probably go back there and ask her, just in case…
Bot: Why are you so interested in that place anyway?
You: I heard it’s safe and that you wouldn’t have to hide there.
#bot.Expression.veryhappy
Bot: Really?!
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Don’t get your hopes up. So far, we don’t even know if any of that is true.
Bot: It seems a bit dangerous with how mysterious it is, but I sure would want to go there! 
You: We will see.
